title: Optimize BM25 tokenizer cleanup
constraints: Preserve existing whitespace-based BM25 token semantics
rationale: The BM25 tokenizer lowercased the entire input and then allocated another cleaned String for each whitespace token with replace. Cleaning each raw token in one pass avoids the whole-input lowercase allocation and removes punctuation while preserving the previous token boundaries.
steps: Rewrite InvertedIndex::tokenize to scan each whitespace token directly
Lowercase and retain only alphanumeric characters while building each token
Filter empty punctuation-only tokens without an extra pass
Add focused unit coverage for punctuation removal and lowercase behavior
expected_impact: Reduces intermediate string allocation during BM25 document indexing and query tokenization.
